item.text:
<linkedin_post>Moonshot’s Kimi K3.1 Pro has reached the API with benchmark scores close to those of leading closed models. Artificial Analysis scored it at 55, behind Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and ahead of GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1 and Gemini 4 Argon at 53.

Moonshot says it will release the full model weights by November 4. If that happens, developers will be able to work with the weights of a model that has scored near the top of this benchmark.

For now, API access costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. Moonshot also offers a Highspeed version that it says runs 2–3 times faster at twice the price for most tokens.</linkedin_post>
